script.title: BOOKING A CLEANING
script.scene_zh: 牙科診所 · 櫃台預約
script.story_hook: A busy mom finally books her dental cleaning.
script.intro_zh: 一位忙碌的媽媽終於來到牙科櫃台預約洗牙。
script.welcome_en: Hello and welcome! Today: booking a dental cleaning.
script.welcome_zh: 你好,歡迎回來!今天來學預約洗牙的對話。
script.outro: Sixty lines done — booking a visit is easy now.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完了,預約看診現在很輕鬆。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to practice — repeat each line aloud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 練習時間到了,請大聲跟讀每一句。
script.char_a_description: a busy mother in her mid thirties with brown hair in a quick bun, wearing a beige trench coat over a striped sweater, dark jeans and low boots, medium build, holding a phone and keys
script.char_b_description: a cheerful receptionist in her early forties with short reddish bobbed hair, wearing a light blue polo shirt with the clinic logo, black slacks and white sneakers, round face and a warm smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈklinɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我想預約洗牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great — have you been here before?
dialogue.zh: 好,您之前來過我們診所嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it's my first visit.
dialogue.zh: 沒有,這是第一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll add exams for new patients.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wil æd ɪɡˈzæmənz fər nu ˈpeɪʃənts/
dialogue.zh: 那我們會加做新病人的檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exams? Like x-rays?
dialogue.zh: 檢查?像是打X光嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, quick pictures of every tooth.
dialogue.zh: 對,幫每顆牙齒拍快速的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… um, that sounds expensive.
dialogue.zh: 好……呃,聽起來很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have dental insurance?
dialogue.zh: 好,您有牙科保險嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes — through my husband's job.
dialogue.zh: 有,透過我先生的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, show me the card.
dialogue.zh: 太好了,請給我看一下保險卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here. Will they cover the cleaning?
dialogue.zh: 在這。洗牙他們給付嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, two cleanings a year.
dialogue.zh: 通常給付,一年兩次洗牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cleanings a year — good to know.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ˈklinɪŋz ə jɪr ɡʊd tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一年兩次洗牙,知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me run your card… one moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi rʌn jɔr kɑrd wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 我刷一下您的卡,請稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time. Is she nodding?
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。她點頭是好事嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news — you're almost fully covered.
dialogue.zh: 好消息,您幾乎全額給付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hooray for small wins!
dialogue.zh: 小小的僥倖也是開心!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, when works for you?
dialogue.zh: 那麼,您什麼時間方便?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mornings are best — after school drop-off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋz ɑr bɛst ˈæftər skuːl drɑp ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 早上最好,送完孩子以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see… Thursday at nine fifteen?
dialogue.zh: 我看看……週四九點十五好嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, Thursday can't work — soccer practice.
dialogue.zh: 噢,週四不行,小孩有足球練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about Friday at eight thirty?
dialogue.zh: 那週五早上八點半可以嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday mornings are golden for me.
dialogue.zh: 週五早上對我來說太珍貴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked in — eight thirty, new patient.
dialogue.zh: 都訂好了,八點半,新病人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Oh wait… one big question.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju oʊ weɪt wʌn bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝!噢,等等,有一個大問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead — I've heard it all.
dialogue.zh: 請說,什麼問題我都聽過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it hurt? I hate the drill sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt hərt aɪ heɪt ðə drɪl saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 會痛嗎?我很討厭鑽牙的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cleanings don't need drills, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說,洗牙不用鑽頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Then what do they use?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎?那他們用什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tiny scaler that buzzes off plaque.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪni ˈskeɪlər ðæt ˈbʌzəz ɔf plæk/
dialogue.zh: 一個會震動的小刮器,清掉牙垢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buzzing… that sounds strange.
dialogue.zh: 震動……聽起來怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like an electric toothbrush.
dialogue.zh: 感覺像電動牙刷在刷牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I can handle that.
dialogue.zh: 好,這個我可以應付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most first-timers do — no drama.
dialogue.zh: 大多數第一次的人都沒問題,一點都不誇張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. How long does a cleaning take?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ə ˈklinɪŋ teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 好,洗牙一次要多久?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About an hour with the x-rays.
dialogue.zh: 加X光大約一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour… but who watches my daughter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈaʊər bʌt wu ˈwɑtʃəz maɪ ˈdɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 一個小時……但誰來照顧孩子呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids are welcome here — we love them.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz ɑr ˈwɛlkəm hɪr wi lʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡歡迎小孩,我們很愛孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? She's four and very loud.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎?她四歲,還很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Perfect, she'll make friends fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ pərfɪkt ʃi l meɪk frɛndz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 哈!太好了,她會很快就交到朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. So what should I bring Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ wʌt ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那週五我該帶什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The card, photo ID, and a list of meds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌaɪˈdi ænd ə lɪst ʌv mɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 保險卡、附照片的證件,還有用藥清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meds? I only take a vitamin.
dialogue.zh: 用藥?我只吃維生素。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring that too — dentists ask about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðæt tuː ˈdɛntɪsts æsk əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個也帶,牙醫會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Any forms to fill out first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛni fɔrmz tə fɪl aʊt fərst/
dialogue.zh: 了解。要先填什麼表單嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the history sheet, or online tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə ˈhɪstri ʃit ɔr ˌɑnˈlaɪn təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 病史資料表就好,或今晚線上填。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Online works. Wait… oh no — Friday!
dialogue.zh: 線上填最好。等等……噢不,週五!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What happened? We can move it.
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了?行程我們可以改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister visits that day — can we shift?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstər ˈvɪzɪts ðæt deɪ kæn wi ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 那天我姊姊要來,能換時間嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course — Monday at eight thirty instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ˈmʌnˌdeɪ æt ˈeɪt ˈθɜrti ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以,改成週一八點半怎麼樣?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mondays are crazy — Saturdays?
dialogue.zh: 週一太瘋狂,有週六嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We open late Saturdays — ten sharp.
dialogue.zh: 週六我們開得晚,十點整剛好有位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday at ten — that's the one!
dialogue.zh: 週六十點,就是它了!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked. We'll text you a reminder.
dialogue.zh: 訂好了,我們會發簡訊提醒您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. I forget everything by lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du aɪ fərˈɡɛt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ baɪ lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 拜託發了,我一忙就全忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've met your type — lovingly.
dialogue.zh: 我們常見到您這類型,是帶著愛說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Thanks for all your patience.
dialogue.zh: 哈!謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime — see you Saturday!
dialogue.zh: 不客氣,週六再見!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye! And sorry about the panic.
dialogue.zh: 再見!剛才那樣慌張,真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No panic here — just clean teeth!
dialogue.zh: 這裡不慌張,只負責把牙齒弄乾淨!
